newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, late surge lifts Dec.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, late surge lifts Dec.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mixed, with the December contract gaining late on spillover strength in Kansas City and Chicago, traders said.
"There wasn't a lot of volume all day, and then Chicago just took off at the end. That helped our spread widen out some more," a floor source said.
Traders also reported some commercial firms had sold MGE March and bought CBOT March wheat.
Spring wheat had been lower at the midsession dealings on light fund selling and spillover weakness from CBOT corn and beans, traders said.
MGE spring wheat closed eight cents per bushel lower to 4-1/2 cents higher, with Dec up 4-1/2 cents at $4.18-1/4.
The MGE estimated spring wheat futures volume at 18.594 million bushels, versus 20.021 million on Thursday.
MGE barley closed two to five cents per cwt higher, with Dec up two cents at $6.95.
